blocks.text: Fyang Smith reacted to being called the next “horror princess,” a title often associated with Kris Aquino and Kim Chiu, saying she considers it a big responsibility given the legacy of those who came before her. Smith, who is set to star in the 2026 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) horror entry “Haunted Carnival,” said she has yet to fully embrace the label, noting that she is still relatively new to the horror genre. “Sa sobrang laking pangalan niya, hindi ko pa tine-take na ganoon ako.
